description: Automated trust-based governance policy replacing manual approval gates for REM-P0-006 closure

controls.description: Workflow must authenticate via GitHub Actions OIDC token from the expected repository
All commits in the assessed release range must be signed (GPG, SSH, or S/MIME)
Closure workflow must execute in a GitHub Environment with required reviewers
The assessed release SHA must be a direct ancestor of the workflow HEAD
Assessor organization must differ from project organization; independence verified by workflow context

rules.description: All critical controls must pass for closure
Readiness mode requires OIDC identity verification only
